svg.title: Restore the session, continue the login
svg.desc: A fixed Chrome profile restores session data. A filled Duke login and Duo device trust advance through the executor. Remaining verification is reported after fifteen seconds.
svg.text: A / Keep the same browser profile
Offline: prepare preferences. Running: Chrome Settings.
B / Advance the selected task tab
Confirm “Yes, trust browser” / “Yes, this is my device”
Duo page or visible Duo iframe inside Duke
Wait 15 seconds; restart the wait after each automatic click
